title: matchRoutes
summary: Find the first route whose pattern matches a pathname.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: routes is ordered. pathname is only the URL pathname, excluding query and hash.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.
sections.code:
const match = matchRoutes(routes, new URL(request.url).pathname);
console.log(match?.params.id);

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Matching is case-sensitive. One trailing slash is ignored. Supports static segments, :parameters, and terminal *. Invalid percent sequences are decoded using URLSearchParams replacement behavior rather than throwing. Static routes must precede dynamic ones in a manual table.

sections.title: Repeated matching
sections.body: Parsed path patterns are reused in a bounded cache of up to 256 entries. Route order and current modules still determine each match; params and loader results are never cached here. Replacing a route object or changing its path remains supported. Eviction only requires parsing the pattern again.
